nodes.name: Sklearn Linear Model Coordinate Descent Path Residuals Writeable Array Shell Helper Atoms
nodes.description: Deterministic dense-only and per-array writeability helpers from sklearn.linear_model._coordinate_descent._path_residuals before _pre_fit.

nodes.name: cd_path_residuals_dense_writeable_guard
nodes.description: Return whether _path_residuals enters the dense writeable-array guard loop.

inputs.name: X_is_sparse
inputs.type_desc: whether the original X input is sparse

outputs.name: result
outputs.type_desc: whether the dense-only writeability loop runs

nodes.name: cd_path_residuals_array_needs_writeable_fix
nodes.description: Return whether _path_residuals calls array.setflags(write=True) for one array.

inputs.name: array_writeable
inputs.type_desc: whether the array is already writeable

outputs.name: result
outputs.type_desc: whether the writeability fix is required

nodes.name: cd_path_residuals_writable_array
nodes.description: Return the array after sklearn's conditional setflags(write=True) normalization.

inputs.name: array
inputs.type_desc: finite numeric rank-1 or rank-2 sliced array

inputs.name: array_input
inputs.type_desc: original source object paired with the array in the sklearn loop

outputs.name: result
outputs.type_desc: same array object, writeable when the guard requires it
